title: Medifast Confirms Appointment of Nicholas Johnson as Chief Executive Officer
summary: Johnson will succeed Dan Chard as CEO; Chard to remain Chairman of the Board Medifast, Inc. (NYSE: MED) today announced that its Board of Directors has formally appointed Nicholas Johnson as Chief Executive Officer, effective June 1, 2026. Johnson will succeed Dan Chard as CEO, who will continue to serve as Chairman of the Board. The appointment follows the leadership transition plan that the company disclosed in January and reflects the Board’s confidence in Johnson’s leadership and the company’s strategic direction.
